ttt_vs_stub_outcomes.note: TTT here = CLIP/clip_local backend. Stub = observation-vla-stub-v1.
ttt_vs_stub_outcomes.finding: Stub assessments were rated more useful (0.867 vs 0.647) and accepted more often by operators (13/14 vs 4/23). CLIP/TTT systematically under-confident (mean 0.469 vs 0.817), recommending refine 96% of the time. Possible causes: CLIP not calibrated for these scenarios, or selection bias in which traces operators reviewed for each backend.
